text:
nina: starting a short thread to lock the long-term routing + residency asks for the PRD. need decisions today so PMs can split epics.

harry: high level: MVP = geo-affinity + soft-evict + basic telemetry. runway = residency enforcement, hard-evict automation for Dedicated, override webhooks.

leah: sales asks: two enterprise customers require signed residency commitments and an eviction SLA in contract. theyre asking for a Private beta by Q3.

morgan: infra reality: hard-evict automation touches KV-cache sharding and in-flight state. estimate: 6w for core infra + 2w validation. We should not promise earlier than Q3.

nina: proposal: commit to residency beta for Private customers in Q3 with clear caveats. For Dedicated we'll promise hard-evict SLA in the contract but mark it as "pending implementation" until Q4. Legal okay with that?

legal: we can accept "beta residency" language but need explicit scope: regions supported, pilot customers only, no SLA credits until implemented. will draft clause.

harry: cost guardrails: by default routing policies must not increase tenant spend > 10%. If exceeded, fallback to cost-aware model variant. Finance sign-off required for any higher default.

leah: customers also want audit trail for eviction events and tenant notifications. propose opt-in webhook for eviction events plus console history.

morgan: telemetry tags to include: policy, action (route/evict/failover), region, cost-delta, evict-reason, tenant-id. Needed for postmortems and Optimize recommendations.

nina: acceptance criteria for MVP (short):
- policy precedence doc published (owner: harry)
- canary plan with 3 tenants and rollback playbook (owner: nina)
- console shows eviction events + cost delta (owner: leah)
- legal residency clause draft (owner: legal)

harry: rollout guardrails: automatic rollback if 99th-pct latency regresses > 12% over baseline for 10m OR error rate > 2% for 5m. Also manual rollback via CLI.

morgan: add burst circuit: max autoscale multiplier = 2x baseline for 5m, then throttle routes to protect capacity. Also token-budget per-tenant default = 10% spend delta.

leah: sample canary CLI for ops (keep for runbook):
```
# route 3% of tenant traffic to routing-beta policy for 48h
redwoodctl routing canary --tenant tenant-omega --policy routing-beta --pct 3 --duration 48h
```

nina: decision summary: conservative MVP (geo-affinity + soft-evict + telemetry) for NA/EU, residency beta targeted for Q3 (Private only), Dedicated hard-evict SLA promised in contract with implementation targeted Q4. Override webhooks = opt-in beta. Owners: harry -> policy doc, nina -> canary plan, leah -> telemetry + customer runbook, legal -> residency clause.

harry: I'll draft the precedence matrix and include the YAML example of ordering and conflicts.

legal: I'll circulate the contract language by EOD, flagging any blocking phrasing.

morgan: I'll prototype the burst circuit and eviction audit log in staging and link tickets.

infra-bot: created ticket PRD-9001 (residency-beta-planning) assigned to morgan.

nina: thanks. please add any missing risks here by noon. If no objections, we'll lock this into the PRD and start sprinting. :white_check_mark:
